messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated gateway errors detected — 5xx rate in eu-west-1 jumped to ~11% over the last 3m (mainly 503/504). Auto-alerting threshold breached. Initiating incident thread.
Ana O'Neill: I have the pager. Acknowledging — gathering quick scope.
Jess Carter: Support reporting ~40 tickets in EU, several customers seeing image generation timeouts. Most traces from support links show gateway 503 with no upstream id.
Raj Patel: looks like a routing/proxy layer failure. I'm not seeing consistent upstream request IDs in the gateway logs for the failing requests, which makes tracing hard.
Sophie Liu: Confirmed — sampling/trace headers are sparse for the error window. Our trace backend shows a region of requests with no spans for gateway -> runtime hops.
Mike Turner: Any recent infra changes in eu-west? I see a tiny proxy config rollout 45m ago (rollout-2026-03-15-proxy-routes). Could be related.
Ana O'Neill: OK, priority: (1) quick mitigation to reduce customer impact, (2) add stopgap instrumentation so we can find root cause, (3) preserve data for postmortem.
Raj Patel: For mitigation, we can route traffic away from the new proxy cohort (canary) to the stable pool. Triggering manual routing fallback now.
deploy-bot: Routing override applied: traffic weight for proxy-rollout-2026-03-15 -> 0% in eu-west-1. Canary disabled.
Jess Carter: Noticing immediate drop in new tickets after the override — good sign. But we still need logs for the period we observed errors.
Sophie Liu: Because many requests lack req_id in logs, we can't correlate. Proposed stopgap: inject a lightweight Envoy Lua filter to log a generated request_id and the upstream cluster for any request missing x-request-id, and emit a minimal structured log to stdout. This gives us trace points without touching app code.
Mike Turner: Lua filter sounds reasonable and low-risk. We'll patch the envoy config on the gateway pods with a short-lived filter. I can push a pod patch. Be aware this will increase log volume.
Ana O'Neill: We need to be careful with logging volumes — target only the failing path patterns initially (/v1/generate and /v1/chat).
Raj Patel: I'll add a temporary k8s patch that adds the filter with a condition on path prefix. Also enabling targeted 20% trace sampling for these paths to capture spans for correlation.
Sophie Liu: Snippet for the one-off Envoy Lua filter I'll use (paste into the k8s patch):
```lua
function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
  local req_id = request_handle:headers():get("x-request-id")
  if req_id == nil then
    req_id = tostring(os.time()) .. "-" .. math.random(1000)
    request_handle:headers():add("x-request-id", req_id)
  end
  local path = request_handle:headers():get(":path") or "-"
  local cluster = request_handle:streamInfo():upstreamCluster() or "-"
  request_handle:logInfo(string.format("stopgap_req id=%s path=%s cluster=%s", req_id, path, cluster))
end
```
Raj Patel: I'll target the filter with an envoy match on path: prefix /v1/generate and /v1/chat; applying only to gateway pods in eu-west-1-tagged nodes.
Mike Turner: Command I'll run to patch gateway deployment (will create a temporary configmap and reload):
```bash
kubectl -n platform patch deployment gateway-proxy -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"stopgap-injection":"true"}}}}'
# then apply envoy configmap with the lua filter and rollout restart
kubectl -n platform apply -f envoy-stopgap-euw.yaml
kubectl -n platform rollout restart deployment/gateway-proxy
```
Ana O'Neill: Good. Raj, Sophie — after the patch is in, capture a few minutes of logs and export to a bucket (keep for postmortem). Also capture sample traces and set TTL on that bucket to 30 days since this is a production incident.
Raj Patel: Will do. One more issue: our logging pipeline currently drops logs without req_id at the ingest layer (smart-drop). That's why older logs vanished. As part of the stopgap we need to bypass smart-drop for the next 30m so we retain the stopgap logs. Mike, can you make a temporary rule?
Mike Turner: Yes. I'll add an ingest rule to retain logs from gateway-proxy pods for 30m, and add a label so we can delete them later.
Jess Carter: Support: can we surface a short status to affected customers? If routing rollback is helping, let's post a status update: "Partial outage in EU region mitigated — routing fallback in place, investigating cause."
Oliver Kim: Agreed. I'll draft a brief update and coordinate with support for the messaging. Keep it factual and avoid speculation.
deploy-bot: Envoy configmap applied; gateway-proxy restarted in eu-west-1. New pods coming up.
Sophie Liu: I'm starting to see the injected logs now — entries look like `stopgap_req id=... path=/v1/generate cluster=gateway-runtime-12`. Good, we can see which upstream cluster is receiving the failing requests.
Raj Patel: Early sample shows a spike of 503s targeted at gateway-runtime-12 and runtime-13. Both show increased 504s on long-running requests. Might be upstream saturation or an unhealthy runtime node pool.
Mike Turner: Checking node metrics — runtime-13 had a memory pressure event around the same window, OOMs in a subset of pods. That could explain timeouts.
Ana O'Neill: Action items so far: (A) short-term rollback of canary (done), (B) inject lua logging (done), (C) retain logs and enable targeted sampling (in progress), (D) scale up runtime pool and cordon problematic nodes (Raj+Mike).
Raj Patel: Scaling runtime pool now and cordoning node node-eu-13 for investigation.
Jess Carter: Support: customers on higher tiers saw increased latency then failures; I'm prioritizing callbacks for top 5 customers. I'll add notes to the incident channel for handoff to account teams.
Ana O'Neill: Handoff: I'm going offline in 15m — Raj, take primary on-call for mitigation and postmortem lead. Checklist: ensure logs/traces exported, keep stopgap for 30m, capture timeline, and create incident ticket.
Raj Patel: Taking it. I'll keep this thread updated. Also creating an incident ticket INC-2026-042 (will attach logs).
Sophie Liu: Reminder: the lua filter is only a stopgap; we should plan to add permanent request-id propagation at the proxy and ensure smart-drop doesn't discard logs without req_id. Also add a test to catch missing spans in the e2e smoke tests.
Mike Turner: Agreed — after stabilization I'll open infra PRs for a permanent fix (health checks on runtime pool, stronger backpressure, and log retention adjustments).
Ana O'Neill: Thanks all — moving to async, Raj will continue. Once we have stable error rates <1% for 15m, we'll close the incident and schedule a postmortem.
Raj Patel: Update: routing rollback + scale + cordon reduced 5xx to ~0.9% in eu-west-1. Logs and stopgap traces captured in s3://incidents/4042109876/stopgap-logs. I'll start the postmortem draft.
Oliver Kim: I'll coordinate the customer-facing timeline for the postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident state changed: monitoring -> mitigated.
Ana O'Neill: Great work everyone. Remember to remove the stopgap lua filter and revert ingest retention rule once logs are archived.
Jess Carter: Noted — I'll follow up with support messaging updates and customer callbacks.
Raj Patel: Closing loop: creating a follow-up ticket to deprecate the faulty canary config and add a pre-rollout integration test for proxy routing.
Sophie Liu: I'll add the test to the runtime CI.
Raj Patel: End of thread — moving to postmortem channel shortly.
